name: ANSSI Signature 24K Gold Filigree Basin
description: The crown jewel of the ANSSI collection. Hand-poured vitreous china finished in high-gloss imperial emerald green, framed with hand-gilded 24K gold filigree floral scrollwork and a solid brushed gold rim. Engineered with anti-bacterial nano-glaze and precision overflow drainage for luxury powder suites.

name: Imperial Emerald Matte Oval Basin
description: Sleek organic geometry sculpted for modern architectural residences. Features a velvety matte emerald exterior with an ultra-thin curved lip accented by a delicate gold border rim. Smooth contoured basin slopes gently for splash-free drainage.
features: Pair with tall basin mixer or wall spout

name: Calacatta Gold Fluted Italian Marble Basin
description: Carved from a solid block of genuine Italian Calacatta marble, showcasing dramatic natural golden and warm grey veining. The exterior boasts architectural vertical fluting carved with sub-millimeter precision, contrasted by a hand-polished water reservoir.
features: Carved from single block natural stone
Natural unique stone veining per piece

name: Noir Minimalist Ultra-Thin Matte Basin
description: Architectural minimalism at its peak. The Noir basin delivers an elongated oval silhouette with a knife-edge thin rim, finished in deep matte black. Non-reflective surface resists water spots and soap buildup for effortless upkeep.
features: Compatible with matte black or brushed brass hardware

name: Chiseled Tuscan Travertine Monolith Basin
description: Embodying raw organic luxury, this round vessel sink is chiseled by hand from natural Tuscan travertine stone. The rough-hewn textured rim highlights earth-formed strata and natural cavities, paired with a silky honed inner bowl.

name: Lumina Backlit Honey Onyx Gemstone Basin
description: An ethereal centrepiece crafted from translucent natural honey onyx gemstone. When paired with vanity sub-lighting or ambient bath illumination, the stone glows with warm crystalline light, revealing millions of years of layered geological amber veins.
features: A true collector one-of-a-kind art piece

name: Sage Olive Organic Curved Vanity Bowl
description: Inspired by the organic contours of river stones and ANSSI's signature earth palette. Features a softly squared organic bowl with curved corners in a satin matte sage olive green glaze. Creates a tranquil spa sanctuary in any washroom.

name: Venetian Terrazzo Handcrafted Basin
description: A contemporary tribute to historic Venetian craftsmanship. Hand-cast composite embedded with genuine Italian marble chips in forest green, amber ochre, and warm cream. Diamond-polished to a silky matte honed finish and UV-sealed.

name: Alabaster Fluted Scallop Matte White Basin
description: Timeless sculptural poise. Vertical scalloped fluting graces the cylindrical exterior, catching rhythmic shadows throughout the day. Finished in pure alabaster matte white with an effortless stain-resistant porcelain glaze inside.
features: Smooth radius corners for gentle flow
Pairs with marble or timber countertops

name: Aureum Brushed Champagne Gold PVD Basin
description: Pure metallic luxury. Fabricated with surgical-grade 304 stainless steel coated in an aerospace Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) titanium layer in champagne gold. Satin hairline brush finish reflects light with warmth and grace without fingerprint smudge.
features: Matches brass and warm gold sanitary fittings

name: Nero Marquina Hand-Chiseled Black Marble Basin
description: Bold, moody and uncompromising. Sourced from Basque quarries, this Nero Marquina bowl features intense black stone intersected by dramatic white calcite lightning veins. Chiseled perimeter texture frames a mirror-smooth basin bowl.
features: Deep black with distinct white calcite veins

name: Aegean Cobalt Reactive Glaze Artisan Basin
description: High-fired at 1280°C to produce spectacular crystalline pooling in shades of deep marine cobalt, turquoise, and cosmic blue. The reactive mineral glaze creates an undulating watery optical depth that mimics the Mediterranean sea.
features: Every firing produces a unique visual pattern

name: Terracotta Artisan Bowl with Hammered Brass Rim
description: Rooted in ancient pottery traditions, this basin combines warm sun-baked terracotta clay with a hand-hammered raw brass collar rim. Sealed with a glassy amber ceramic slip interior that protects the earthenware while honoring raw tactile warmth.
features: Ideal for resort villas and heritage restorations
